# `=` — Equal

`=Y` self-classifies the major cells of `Y`. The result has a row for each distinct cell, in order of first occurrence, and a column for each cell of `Y`. An entry is `$t` where its column's cell equals its row's cell.

```bpl
="aba"            ⍝ [$t $f $t ⋄ $f $t $f]
```

`X=Y` tests equality, pervasively. NaN equals nothing, as IEEE 754 defines.

```bpl
1 2 3=2            ⍝ $f $t $f
0.3=0.1+0.2        ⍝ $t
"abc"='b'          ⍝ $f $t $f
```

See [tolerance](../evaluation.qmd#equality-and-ordering) and whole-array [match `≡`](match.qmd).
